mapper.select: SELECT ce.card_expense_id, ce.transaction_id, ce.approval_status, ce.classification_status, ceu.group_id FROM card_expense ce JOIN card_expense_upload ceu ON ceu.upload_id = ce.upload_id WHERE ce.card_expense_id = #{cardExpenseId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT gt.transaction_id FROM group_transaction gt JOIN group_account ga ON ga.account_id = gt.account_id WHERE ga.group_id = #{groupId} AND gt.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND gt.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE card_expense SET final_category = #{finalCategory}, classification_status = 'CONFIRMED', classification_source = 'USER', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE card_expense_id = #{cardExpenseId}
